Novel Algorithms Introduced
Li‑Mamba
Selective State Space Model
First application of selective state space models to battery SOC estimation. Achieves 2.6× faster inference and 4.4× lower memory than Transformers, with 0.65% RMSE.
BatteryGPT
Transformer-based Predictor
Purpose-built Transformer for battery degradation forecasting. Self-attention for long-range temporal modeling of SOC, SOH, and RUL prediction sequences.
Federated Ensemble with Uncertainty
5-Model Ensemble
RF + XGBoost + LSTM + MLP + GP with aleatoric/epistemic uncertainty separation, confidence calibration, and online learning for continual adaptation.
WOA‑Optimized Parameter Estimation
Whale Optimization Algorithm
Whale Optimization Algorithm for adaptive real-time tuning of battery internal resistance and capacity. Minimizes voltage prediction error every 300 seconds.
Multi‑Scale GPR Feature Engineering
Gaussian Process Regression
GPR-based synthetic anomaly generation across 396 features (3 scales × 22 params × 6 stats). Significantly improves model robustness and training data quality.
